name: restaurant-default-warehouse
title: Create a default warehouse with every restaurant
description: Make restaurant creation atomically create its first warehouse and give legacy restaurants a focused warehouse setup state in the manager inventory UI.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Flow traced from Restaurant and Warehouse models through createRestaurant/createWarehouse, Apollo warehouse operations, StorageManagement and Header. The creation invariant was added at the restaurant mutation boundary; the UI now provides a permission-aware recovery path for legacy restaurants with zero warehouses. PR #1306 is open and CI is pending.
